en: ?  A sanctuary?  Why would something like this be inside a labyrinth?
Eh?  Mikhail?!
Yes, milady.  I'm so pleased to see you doing well.
What on Earth are you doing here?  Weren't you waiting back at the manor?!
I waited here figuring that I might be of some assistance to you.
You did, huh.  Hmmmmmm?
What is it.  Why might you be looking at me like that?
No-rea-son.
So, what are you here to help me with?
Ahem.  Well then, milady.  First, please look over there.
?  What is that thing?
For now, please go stand there.
Huh?  Why should I?
Just go do it!
Okay, okay, I'm going.  No need to shout.
How's this?
Huh?  W-wait, what is this?
Kyaaaaaaaaaaa!
Mikhail!
W-what is it, all of the sudden?
Do you know anything about something called a genomroid?
N-no, unfortunately I don't.
Eh?  Are you sure?
Y-yes.  I completely, absolutely, know not even a smidgen.
That's odd.  Genomroid was Father's research project.  Being his assistant, there's no way you couldn't know.
Although you say that, I, er...
Suspicious.
...okay, I get it.
Huh?
It's fine!  I'll look into it on my own!
M-milady?!
Mikhail, don't try to stop me!
You don't have to tell me yourself but I am going to find out.
.....understood.
Welp, where should I start looking?
The basement laboratory seems the most obvious place for clues.
Right!  I'll head straight there.
Uggh....
Lady Alice?  Has something happened?
Not much.  I'm just feeling dizzy...
A-are you all right?
To be safe, should you not rest up in the manor for a time?
Don't make too big of a deal out of it.  I'm fine.  Just need to take a little break...
Aaaaaaah!
Lady Alice?!
Milady! Lady Alice!!
Welcome back.  I am so pleased to see you safe.
Fear not, for the warp gate is fully operational.
Take care on your journey.
Mikhail!  Do you know how to break a gordalis?
Gordalis!  Milady where did you hear that word?
I found father being held inside one.
Is that so.
Hmm..  That presents quite the problem.
Well, Mikhail.  Isn't there some way to break it?  Well?  Well?
It's not as though we have zero options, but...
Okay, please tell me what needs to be done.
This is going to be rather troublesome.
Oh sheesh.  Stop beating around the bush and spill it, would you!
I'm willing to try anything I have to if it means being able to save Father.
Very well.  In that case there are some things I must ask you to find.
What should I be looking for?
Two sacred items are required to free the professor.
Sacred items?  Well which ones for heaven's sake?
I do not know.  I suppose they'd have to be ones that could wear down evil power...
All right.  And?  Where are those going to be?
Most likely somewhere inside the labyrinth.  I'm a bit lacking in particulars....
Great.  I'm clueless as to where I should start looking, and I don't know much about what I'm looking for.
I agree, that certainly is a pain.
But I've got to go through with it!
Can you handle it?
Yep, I'm absolutely going to come back with them!
If you should locate anything, please bring it here at once.
All right.
It's just like me to talk big even though I've nary a clue to go on.  Better start by gathering some intel.
How about I try asking the vampire?  He seems like he might know something about sacred items.
Mikhail, I found them!  A bible and holy water!
Look!  These should work for sacred items right?
Oh!  That's it!  Those shall do nicely!
Oh thank goodness!  Now that we have these, we can help Father right?
No, collecting those was just step one.  Please take this.
What's this, a pattern?  Hm?  Does that mean step two is sewing a dress from this?
You are correct, milady.
And, once you've finished everything, something ought to happen.
And what is that something?
You'll see when the time comes.  For now please just trust me.
Fair enough, Mikhail.  I'll take your word for it.
You have my thanks.  Now, milady.  Hurry to a sewing room!
Right!

note: sfx: Obtained the pattern for the magic dress Argus

en: I've got myself some holy water.  Better find the other one fast.
I've collected both sacred items.
Now, let's show them to Mikhail.
In order to craft the dress Argus,
you'll need akubaru, tyuunu, fomoru, and oreusu.
These items are frequently carried by monsters on B30F.
Good luck, milady.
Milady.  Have you gathered the sacred items?
I found holy water, but I'm still working on the other one.
Please try to hurry!  We don't have much more time!
I know that already!  But I don't have any other leads...
I-I see.
Anything at all no matter how small would help.  Can you think of anything, Mikhail?
I wish I could, but...
Actually, I wonder.
The wizards might know something useful.
Why's that?
Sacred items and magic are related, or so I've heard.  Thus it stands to reason they ought to...
Makes sense, Mikhail!  I'll try looking for a wizard!
Good luck.  And take care.
Hi there.
Milady you must be tired.  Would you take a short break here?
Nah, I'm hurrying ahead.
I see.  You sure are pushing yourself hard, milady.
Aw, no backseat adventuring, please.  Unless you're asking to take over for me?
Eh?!
No, I mean..  that is..  well..
Oh, speaking of!
Dodging the issue, are we?
W-well...
No matter.  Continue.
Certainly.
I had a thought: Your late mother used to be skilled in dressmaking.  There's a pattern that might still be in her room.
Ohh, my mom was...?
How about searching for it?
Sure will.  Thank you, Mikhail!
